formula: Start with exact bytes UTF8('R05-BLINDED-REAL-V2') followed by one NUL byte.

Append GitHub PushEvent id, ref, and created_at in that exact order. Each is unmodified ASCII/UTF-8 from the exact canonical GitHub JSON and is framed as uint32 little-endian byte length followed by those bytes. No Unicode normalization, whitespace change, case change, NUL or alternate timestamp spelling is permitted.
Append raw 20 bytes decoded from the lowercase 40-hex manifest git commit.
Append raw 32 bytes decoded from the lowercase 64-hex canonical freeze-manifest SHA-256.
Append raw 32 bytes decoded from the lowercase 64-hex BLS-verified drand randomness.
No field count, delimiter, terminator or trailing byte follows. seed32 is SHA-256 of the resulting bytes.
required_tests: Selector and scorer use separate implementations and both equal the fixed vector.
Omitted/reordered event fields, raw-vs-hex commit/manifest/randomness, big-endian length, normalized timestamp/ref, changed domain/NUL and trailing bytes each differ from the fixed vector.
Any selector/scorer disagreement or noncanonical input fails before fixture selection.
review_policy: Medium-only targeted fix; no full reviewer round. This does not authorize implementation beyond the already-approved RED-test authoring boundary.
